source_instruction: i am looking for a multi-colored blackout window film for my living room.
query: I spent all morning rearranging my kitchen spice rack, alphabetizing every jar and tossing out the expired cinnamon that’s been sitting there since 2022, then I noticed my houseplant by the front door has a tiny new leaf unfurling that I almost missed while wiping down the entryway table, and I also remembered I need to pick up extra cat litter on my way home tomorrow because my tabby keeps knocking his current litter box lid off when he’s done using it. I’m looking for window coverings for my living room, specifically the multi-13124 option, and I only want ones that are a good price.
